historia.texto: Depois de três músicas, a banda tocou o Binaural inteiro, na ordem do disco. O Eddie lembrou que o primeiro show deles em Toronto teve só sete músicas. Antes de Evacuation, contou do alarme de incêndio que tocou no hotel e dedicou a música ao povo de Alberta, que enfrentava o incêndio de Fort McMurray, e às equipes de resgate. Em Thin Air, desceu até a grade e um fã com camisa do Seattle Mariners, o JP, cantou com ele no microfone. Sleight of Hand começou errado e ele parou a banda: disco às vezes pula e é preciso limpar a agulha. No bis, avisou que a banda mandaria dinheiro desses shows pra Alberta e pediu as luzes dos celulares acesas pra Imagine. Ainda apresentou um fã de máscara de esqui como Matt Damon, e a guitarrista canadense Donna Grantis tocou em Rockin' in the Free World.

fontes.trecho: Ed reminds the audience of how many shows they have played in Toronto and says the first time they played it was seven songs.
Ed tells a story about the fire alarm going off in their hotel today.

It is a  very different situation for the people in Fort McMurray who are in the middle of the terrible fire.  He dedicates the next song to the people of Alberta and the first responders helping them.)

during Thin Air Ed goes to the barricade to sing with the audience.  One man in a Seattle Mariners jersey gets on the mic and duets with Ed.  When the song is done Ed learns the man’s name and says  “JP, I will meet you after the show you handsome man.”
“you know the thing about records is sometimes they skip and you have to start the song over.  Let me clean the needle off.”  They restart the song
Ed continues noting that they are going to be sending money from these shows to Alberta and Edmonton.
He asks the audience to hold up their phones with the lights on to light up the place.
Ed wants to point out the guy in the audience that is wearing one of the full face ski masks that RNDM wears.
Let me introduce you.  Ladies and gentlemen,  Matt Damon!”
